275:     fun closeBlock(msg: BlockUploaded, logTimestamp: LogTimestamp): PendingBlock {
276:         val uploading = blockState as? Uploading
277:             ?: error("[$dbName] BlockUploaded b${msg.blockIndex.asLexHex} arrived with no block in flight")
278: 
279:         partitionState.adoptBlock(uploading.block, msg.tries, logTimestamp)
280: 
281:         // Publish L0 tries to the source log so that all nodes — including multi-writer nodes running
282:         // concurrently with a single-writer leader — see the L0 before any compaction L1C on the source
283:         // log (see #5395). Once we drop support for multi-writer clusters running concurrently with
284:         // single-writer, this source-log post is no longer required and can be removed.
285:         //
286:         // Both off the persister coroutine, in one launch: this runs on the source log's sole consumer, so
287:         // appending inline self-deadlocks when the source-log buffer saturates at a block boundary — the
288:         // consumer would wait on room only it can make. The launch lets the close return so the persister
289:         // drains and the append's emit finds room; running signalBlock after it in the same coroutine keeps
290:         // compaction's L1C strictly behind the L0 without a separate join.
291:         scope.launch {
292:             sourceLog.appendMessage(
293:                 SourceMessage.TriesAdded(Storage.VERSION, bufferPool.epoch, msg.tries)
294:             )
295:             compactor.signalBlock()
296:         }
297: 
298:         blockState = Filling(0)
299: 
300:         LOG.debug("finished block: 'b${msg.blockIndex.asLexHex}'.")
301: 
302:         return uploading.pendingBlock
303:     }
